entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'or' between a float-valued and a histogram-valued operand has a %s float schema
entries.rationale: mixedExpHistogramSetOp admits this BinaryExpr only when exactly one side is histogram-valued or histogram-forwarding; lowerMixedExpHistogramOperands chooses that side with the identical predicate and names the opposite side floatExpr. The ordinary lowering of that parser-typed vector must therefore publish SampleKindFloat; histogram or mixed was excluded by the recognizer, and opaque or invalid would violate the lowering schema contract.

entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: the immediately preceding guard has proved the lowered float arm is SampleKindFloat. Every PromQL vector producer admitted as that arm publishes a closed schema with named Attributes and Value roles and a valid canonical, anchored, or reduced temporal envelope, so resolveSampleTemporalLayout can fail here only for a malformed internal plan.
